rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, noting compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona, but it hedges/conflicts on whether the embryo is truly hatching versus expanded/partially collapsed and includes some speculative image details.

Integrates key factors well: maternal age as main limiter via aneuploidy risk, prior miscarriage, BMI, tubal factor contingent on hydrosalpinx management, ovarian reserve, endometrium, and semen parameters.
Reasoning is generally logical, but there are internal inconsistencies in implantation estimates and miscarriage/live birth ranges, plus some mixed statements about morphology stage and BMI impact.

Largely aligned with IVF practice: acknowledges limits of morphology, age-related aneuploidy, possible role of PGT-A discussion, importance of hydrosalpinx exclusion, and avoiding bed rest; minor deviations include somewhat loose probability framing.

Provides some practical suggestions such as confirming cavity/hydrosalpinx status, considering PGT-A in future cycles, lifestyle optimization, and follow-up testing, but recommendations are somewhat generic and not highly case-specific.
